threads.subject: Q4 roadmap: need your sign-off by Thursday noon

messages.body: Jordan, I'm locking the Q4 roadmap Thursday at noon so I can share it with the board. Can you confirm the two items we cut (offline mode and the admin audit log) are okay with you, or tell me what you'd swap in? A yes or no in this thread is enough.

Jordan, meet Dana Okafor, a partner at Northlight Ventures. Dana is looking closely at clinical workflow tools, and I told her you're the sharpest product mind I know in the space. Dana, Jordan leads product at Fernwood. I'll let you two take it from here.
Thanks, Lena. Jordan, great to meet you. Do you have 30 minutes for coffee next week? I'm free Tuesday or Wednesday afternoon.
Your verification code is 482913. It expires in 10 minutes. If you didn't request this, ignore this email.

messages.body: This week: agents everywhere, the end of the roadmap as we know it, and three teams who shipped faster with less. Read more inside.

Where should we do the team dinner Wednesday? Tartine or Nopa?
Never mind, I booked Tartine for 6:30 on Wednesday. See everyone there!
